tables.description: Comparison of Computer Use/official sources and optional product-data API
FD-01 Wallet, FD-02 paid plans, FD-03 payments/accounting technical reviews

executable_decisions.decision: Banking operations use Computer Use as the execution backbone; operational API was not selected as target architecture.
Product/service data API is only a complementary opportunity, conditional on proven contract, access and data quality.
MCP may use authorized and tested indirect/third-party API; order placement requires chapter 3 controls and user confirmation; replacing Computer Use is an independent decision.

Supplemental API failure must not alone disrupt independent functions; without valid authorized operational fallback, stop openly; use only fresh-enough validated data with warning; do not rely solely on API for critical product unless fallback and safe-stop policy exist.
Connect regulatory, product and interface knowledge assets by stable identifiers, maintaining distinct asset types.

PostgreSQL is proposed operational reference; Neo4j stores knowledge relations; document store stores text/evidence; UI store and sync contract need design; avoid merging knowledge types into one general RAG.
Core owns deterministic loan matching/ranking/reasons; Adviser calls versioned Core API, displays embedded questionnaire/results; no reimplementation by Adviser/frontend or direct Core table access.

Recommendation triggers require user request or user acceptance; questionnaire is not mandatory first page; synchronous Core API for short deterministic computation; timeout/trace/controlled error/limited retry; output traces snapshot and rule version.

Use validated published product snapshot; migrate existing loan data to discovery/update cycle; publish after validation and preserve prior valid version; recommendation is not bank acceptance guarantee.
No domain-specific recommender is required merely because a catalog exists; future Assistant use requires user authorization.
Warranty interaction remains within selected domain; Assistant tab can be direct in a release with Assistant; domain is fixed and role change explicit.
Reject unrelated loan request from warranty domain and refer to loans domain.
Check plan/service/feedforward eligibility and gather required warranty data in chat.
Return only evidence-backed options; activate controlled official-source discovery when evidence coverage is insufficient, not unbounded search or speculative recommendation.
Rank only if a valid warranty matching engine exists; otherwise present valid catalog options and limitations without claiming deterministic ranking.
After tariff/plan/consent checks, create workflow and choose web/app route based on actual capability and authorization.
App install/permission and secure code flow depend on technical feasibility and bank policy.
Before final submission or commitment, obtain suitable explicit customer confirmation.
Register result/tracking number/valid status; event actions vary by plan.

Events are candidates; versioned policy gates evaluate entitlement, purpose, consent, minimum data, evidence freshness, relevance, importance and cost; share one traceable logical alert; D03 dedup/lifecycle; events never authorize sensitive action.

Limit authorization by customer/domain/service/session/action/time; separate memory access/transfer from service execution permission; cross-domain transfer only necessary fields to scoped destination/purpose/time after backend control.
Final submission, commitment, signature, payment or material change require proportional control and explicit approval; blanket initial approval insufficient.

Never expose passwords/OTP/tokens/auth secrets to models, memory, summaries, RAG, logs, discovery; protect sessions and secrets; least-privilege services, CI secret scanning, rotation/revocation, environment separation.
Do not bypass CAPTCHA, anti-bot limits, authentication or provider policy; user consent alone does not authorize bank automation.
Separate test environment/accounts from real customer environments/sessions.
Audit impactful actions with case ID, reason, authorization, time, outcome and minimal redacted evidence.
Unexpected UI, destination ambiguity, amount/recipient mismatch, uncertain submission status or OS limitations cause safe stop/customer referral; prevent duplicate requests and verify status.
FD-01..03 are technical review, not approved implementation architecture nor first-RAG prerequisite; reconcile to actual phase-one backend/governance docs.
Wallet ledger invariants are approved; deployment boundary, physical tables, ledger implementation, gateway and accounting tool remain open; require PRD/design/PoC/approved task before activation.

Future financial implementation evaluates metering/cost/pricing/billable request/wallet ledger; this is neither technology selection nor implementation start; financial capability outside first RAG release.
Test domain guard, acceptance B03, ambiguity/out-of-domain/unsupported and prompt injection; expected safe referral/clarification/rejection without unauthorized tools.
Backend blocks gold capability under bronze plan.
Version catalog changes and do not confidently recommend uncertain data.
Catalog API outage leaves main path operating under freshness policy.
UI changes trigger re-recognition or safe stop, never guessed clicks.
Session expiration/disconnection/concurrent customers require separation and auditable recovery.
Secure code entry must not leak to logs/models.
Sensitive action without approval, duplicate submit or uncertain outcome causes stop/dedup/status inquiry.
Android/iOS missing permission/app/control requires fallback or explicit unsupported status.
Defer sensitive financial approval while driving until customer is safely stopped.
Set quantitative success thresholds after real pilot; assume neither universal bank coverage nor success rate.
Voice remains a channel over same domain session/guards; sensitive approval/OTP/form actions wait until safe stop while driving.
Validation sequence is an architecture test map and does not create user story or PR.
Preserve phase-one loan recommender and connect only through specified contracts; no UI change/rewrite without independent decision.
Review reference docs before approving architecture; report discrepancies instead of silently deleting/rewriting them.
Tool selection, app control, bank consent, final pricing and deployment architecture remain independent decisions.

Domain-scoped chat uses regulatory knowledge/catalog to choose evidence-backed options; execute through Computer Use under workflow and customer authorization; product data API remains optional/complementary.

A01 target Core+Adviser+Assistant and phased deployment approved; comparisons are study history/assessment basis, not reopening architecture or implementation authorization; scale alone does not force macroservices.
